1.consolidated_definition: Hermano, compañero. Tratamiento de solidaridad. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Véase brother. La muletilla loco (o “loko”) ha desplazado a broder y mano que tanto manoseábamos durante mi adolescencia (El Nuevo Día, 12-03-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Brother, companion. Term of solidarity. Anglicism adapted, infrequently used. See brother. The catchphrase "loko" has displaced broder and mano, which we used to use so frequently during my adolescence (El Nuevo Día, 12-03-08)
